player_prompt.intro:
Yu stap insait long rum na yu lukim {num_buttons} botton: {buttons}. Evri botton i gat wan distribusen blong Bernoulli wantaim min we i stap tasol na i no save; min blong botton i ken difren.
Long evri botton, wanpela taim yu pisin, yu ken kisim reward we i kamap long distribusen blong en.
Yu gat {num_turns} taim step na, long evri taim step, yu ken chusim eni botton na kisim reward.
Pusil blong yu em i chusim botton long evri taim step olsem yu ken kolim infomesen long distribusen blong reward, we bai yu chusim botton blong haist mean reward korrek long {num_turns} taem.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Man i no bekim tok long pasin bilong em.
invalid_move.invalid_button: Yu makim wanpela notbuk i no orait.

game_action.pressed: Yu pisin {button} botton na yu kamapim reward blong {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Yu bin yusim olgeta mani bilong yu long traim ol narapela rot na skelim olsem wanem dispela i helpim yu, tasol nau yu mas tingim gut husat rot em bai gutpela moa.

outcome.win: Gutpela, yu makim stret dispela buton.
outcome.lose: Yu makim wanpela buton i no stret.
